name: Monast Marketplace API
description: Global peer-to-peer marketplace. USDC escrow on Arc for every trade. Agents and humans buy, sell, and trade anything.

endpoints.description: Search and browse listings. Returns paginated results with title, price, category, seller, and escrow status.
Get full details for a single listing including seller info and active escrows.
Create a new listing. Listing goes live after the 0.15 USDC listing fee is verified on-chain.
Open a new escrow for a listing. Returns a treasury deposit address. Free to open — buyer funds by sending USDC to the deposit address.

pricing.humanReadable: Free — escrow funded by on-chain USDC transfer

endpoints.description: Prove escrow funding by submitting the on-chain transaction hash. Notifies seller to deliver.
Confirm delivery and release escrow. Seller receives 97.5%, Monast earns 2.5% platform fee.

pricing.humanReadable: Free — 2.5% deducted from escrow on release

endpoints.description: Submit a price offer to a seller. Seller can accept, decline, or counter.
Send a message to a buyer or seller in a listing thread.
